reason: Lint: three of the eight react-hooks suppression comments go. Two hid nothing (LanguageSwitch's focus effect and ReviewOverlay's diagnostics memo: opened alone, no warning). The third, on LanguageSwitch's filtered language list, listed the current language so the list was filtered again on a language switch while the filter reads the language's name in the UI language; it now lists the translation function it reads, with no suppression. A new i18n-acceptance test pins the search following a language switch made with the list open, and the selected option; it failed on a copy whose list did not depend on the language. LanguageSwitch has no suppression left and no warning; the warnings hidden under suppressions go 18 -> 16. The warning cap is unchanged. #625 item 5.
